{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient appears only once, with the most recent (highest sample_seq) row
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)['severe']

# Print the result
print(fraction_severe)"}
